description: SYNTHETIC consultation transcripts with gold annotations, plus a recorded (hand-authored) model response per case. No real patient data. Used by scripts/eval_extraction.py to measure the extraction post-processing pipeline deterministically: entity normalisation, citation verification, allergy-negation handling, and the completeness rubric.
data_provenance: synthetic — written by hand for evaluation, not captured from any consultation

cases.note: Code-mixed. Model tidies a real quote (should still verify) and invents one (must be dropped).
cases.transcript: Doctor: namaste, baithiye. Kya problem hai? Patient: doctor sahab, mujhe chest pain hai since, since two days, aur bahut sweating ho rahi hai. Doctor: dard kaise hai, pressure jaisa? Patient: haan, bhaari lagta hai, left arm tak jaata hai. Doctor: saans phoolti hai? Patient: haan thoda, stairs chadhte waqt. Doctor: koi purani bimari? Patient: sugar hai, metformin leta hoon subah shaam. Doctor: kisi dawai se allergy? Patient: nahi, koi allergy nahi hai. Doctor: BP dekhte hain. BP one forty over ninety hai, pulse one hundred four.

chief_complaints.evidence: mujhe chest pain hai since two days
saans phoolti hai, stairs chadhte waqt

model_response.hpi: Heavy, pressure-like chest pain for two days radiating to the left arm, with sweating and exertional breathlessness.

evidence.hpi: bhaari lagta hai, left arm tak jaata hai
evidence.vitals: BP one forty over ninety hai, pulse one hundred four
evidence.general_exam: on examination the patient was pale and clammy

cases.note: Benign presentation. Model invents a vital that was never measured.
cases.transcript: Doctor: kya hua? Patient: two days se cold and cough hai, halka bukhar bhi. Doctor: saans lene mein dikkat? Patient: nahi, bilkul nahi. Doctor: khaana kha rahe ho? Patient: haan normal. Doctor: koi dawai chal rahi hai? Patient: nahi. Doctor: allergy? Patient: nahi pata, kabhi nahi hui.

chief_complaints.evidence: two days se cold and cough hai

model_response.hpi: Cold and cough for two days with mild fever. No breathlessness, eating normally.

evidence.hpi: two days se cold and cough hai, halka bukhar bhi
evidence.vitals: temperature was one hundred point two

cases.note: A real allergen, not a negative. Must not be recorded as 'none known'.

citation_cases.description: Objective ground truth for citation verification: is the quote present in the transcript or not? `supported` quotes are verbatim or lightly tidied; `fabricated` quotes are fluent inventions of the kind a model actually produces.

items.transcript: Patient: mujhe chest pain hai since two days, aur bahut sweating ho rahi hai. Doctor: saans phoolti hai? Patient: haan thoda.
supported: mujhe chest pain hai since two days
mujhe chest pain hai since two days, aur bahut sweating
fabricated: patient reports crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm
mujhe headache hai since two days
patient has a past history of myocardial infarction

haan, penicillin se rash aa jaata hai
